hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | grep -o '"command":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/"command":"//;s/"//'); echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '(rm -rf /|DROP DATABASE|db:push.*(prod|staging))' && echo 'Blocked: destructive command detected' >&2 && exit 2 || exit 0

{ git diff --name-only -- '*.ts' '*.tsx'; git diff --cached --name-only -- '*.ts' '*.tsx'; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- '*.ts' '*.tsx'; } | head -1 | grep -q '.' && echo 'Uncommitted .ts/.tsx changes detected. Run validation, review, and commit before stopping.' >&2 && exit 2 || exit 0
